description: Upload a public media URL (image/video/document) to Meta and get a reusable header_handle for a template's media HEADER. Use the returned headerHandle inside a HEADER component: {type:'HEADER',format:'IMAGE',example:{header_handle:[headerHandle]}}.

type.description: Optional MIME type, e.g. image/png, video/mp4, application/pdf.

url.description: Public URL of the media to upload.

name: gambot_upload_template_media
title: Upload template media
